approach: Static recompilation of the 68000 code to native C, with an OpenGL frontend and RetroArch shader presets through librashader
notes: Tengen's 1991 Genesis release. A vertical full-maze view shows every maze whole with no forced scrolling; rewind, save states, preemptive frames and fast forward. Windows x64, x86 and ARM64; Linux x86_64 and aarch64 as a tarball or AppImage. Needs your own copy of the USA/Europe cartridge, checked by its SHA-1; the repository contains no game code or data.
